page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 32 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled with a single local NVMe SSD offering 402 GB of capacity, while no GPU accelerators are present.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the top 25% at 2863.28. Multi-core performance is average, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 11475.63 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6895.0. Memory performance exhibits a notable tradeoff: while small-block cached read bandwidth is average at 565.78 GB/sec, large-block uncached read and write bandwidths are weak to poor, measuring 36.05 GB/sec and 13.63 GB/sec respectively. Text processing is another strong point, scoring in the top 25% on Geekbench.

Given its balanced resource allocation and local NVMe storage, this instance is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, database operations, and software compilation. It handles light LLM inference for small models adequately, though performance drops significantly on medium models. The inclusion of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and local NVMe SSD storage provides a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring fast local scratch space without the overhead of network-attached storage.
